user_checkpoint: Factory commit, task completion, and run acceptance require current independent outcome evidence as well as passing engineering checks.
explicitly_remaining_scope: This factory engineering checkpoint does not complete the proposal UI cleanup or certify recovery of a live career job.

scenarios.state: Green engineering checks with passing, missing, failed, stale, or unsupported outcome review
scenarios.data_volume: Independent criterion/evidence records, actual evidence subprocesses, isolated git repositories, and changed source/served identities
scenarios.load: Serial deterministic regression suite; no live job writes

required_criteria.outcome: With engineering checks green, the actual ADW refuses commit, TaskMaster completion, and run acceptance when independent outcome review fails or evidence is unavailable; complete current evidence permits acceptance.
Changed source, evidence, contract, or served identity invalidates prior approval; missing/duplicate criteria, not-run outcomes, open findings, and screenshots without supported review cannot pass.
Full delivery requirements and repair reports remain available through bounded repairs, and fixture-only engineering scope cannot be declared a live incident without required live/browser evidence.
